control_target_rule: four target mux x choices are [witness_x, witness_x xor 1, witness_x xor 1, witness_x xor 1]; these are validation controls, not the Q1420 public target workload
positive_rule: fix six leaf masks, leaf x/z words, four projective intermediate X/Z words, and target choice 0 to the archived group witness
negative_rule: same fixed witness inputs but target choice 1, which changes target x bit zero
free_rule: fix only six leaf masks and target choice 0; solve leaf coordinates and all projective intermediates
positive_acceptance: SAT with every CNF and native XOR constraint independently checked, decoded leaf signs, all four decoded intermediate x classes, and exact group target replay
negative_acceptance: UNSAT with an explicit terminal status
free_acceptance: SAT with the same independent model/group replay, or preserve a capped BOUNDED_UNKNOWN diagnostic
cpu_isolation: unverified; wall times are exploratory stage diagnostics
